text: ムシじゃ　なくて　くさで　あしを　きってた　みたい

structure.en: it wasn't a bug, but rather

structure.jp: あしを　きってた　みたい
structure.en: it seems I'd cut my leg

patterns.name: 〜ではなくて
patterns.explanation: ではなくて means 'not this, but something else'; じゃ is the spoken short form of では. ムシじゃ　なくて = 'not a bug, but'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.explanation: みたい at the end means 'it looks like' or 'it seems'. きってた is a short きっていた. きってた　みたい = 'it seems I had cut it'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows what was used or what did it. くさで = 'with the grass', so the grass is what cut the leg.
